deploymentToken.title: Teams Lite deployment token
deploymentToken.description: Organization deployment token issued from the Teams Lite admin portal. When present (and autoEnroll is not false), an unenrolled browser exchanges it once for its own per-install credential. It authorizes enrollment only and is never itself an install credential.

autoEnroll.title: Auto-enroll from the deployment token
autoEnroll.description: Set to false to stop browsers from enrolling automatically from deploymentToken (for example while staging). Defaults to true when a token is present.
